parsed.note_claim: The Sagrada Família is not fully complete; while the central Tower of Jesus Christ was finished in 2026, other elements remain unfinished.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: In 2026, the tallest tower of the Basilica, at 172.5 meters, will be completed. A key step that brings us closer to the final stage of the Temple's construction.
